description:
Master the roughest roads with Raso TC, a special edition of our all-road aero endurance bike formed from Tri-Composite tubing for elevated comfort and exceptional strength.

Built upon decades of cutting-edge composite development and in-house tube and frame manufacturing at our HQ in Veneto, Italy, Raso TC takes a fresh look at fast.

From postcard roads to less-than-perfect pavé, Raso TC’s uni-directional carbon fibre augmented with metallic filaments delivers enhanced comfort and strength by minimizing vibrations and localized mechanical stresses throughout the frame.

With its streamlined one-piece cockpit and smooth custom-formed tubes that optimize the air at every angle, Raso TC brings real-world speed to every ride. And with space for up to 35mm tires, your next personal best could be your plushest yet.

Comfort starts with control. Raso TC’s flared bars perfectly align with the natural flow of your shoulders and arms for a reassuringly comfortable connection over long distances and epic descents.

Like every Sarto, Raso TC is available in custom sizing, tailored to your precise dimensions or off-the-shelf stock measurements.

And then there’s the finish.

From ombre fades to geometric patterns via standout seasonal colours, our in-house paint shop can take the personalisation of your dream ride to a whole new level.

frame.material_detail: M46J/CN80/T800 carbon, Tri-Composite Carbon Fiber outer layer
